get_testdata_combo

Source: R/helpers-tests.R
get_testdata_combo.Rd

Function to obtain data from gDRtestData and prepare for unit tests

Usage

get_testdata_combo()

Value

list with drugs, cell_lines, raw_data and assay_data

Examples

get_testdata_combo()
